description:
Cast Rot Hulk by paying {5}{B}{B}.
Rot Hulk enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Dual Nature.
Holding priority, activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Rot Hulk.
Dual Nature's second ability triggers, exiling all tokens named Rot Hulk.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Rot Hulk trigger from step 2, failing to return anything to the battlefield.
Resolve the Dual Nature trigger from step 2, creating a token copy of Rot Hulk.
The token copy of Rot Hulk enters the battlefield, returning Rot Hulk from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
